skill_name: Explain the ethical implications of building an AI-controlled healthcare system
workflow: Building an AI-controlled healthcare system could bring both positive and negative ethics implications. On the positive side, AI-controlled healthcare systems could allow better access to healthcare and enable doctors to access data more quickly. On the negative side, AI-controlled healthcare systems can lead to the potential for healthcare data to be used inappropriately and AI algorithms to misdiagnose cases and make mistakes.
